story.iWant: to remove temporary test files and artifacts from Epic 1
story.soThat: the codebase is clean and production-ready before Epic 2 development begins
story.tasks:
- Task 1: Remove environment variable test files (from Story 1.3) - Delete app/api/test-env/route.ts and directory - Delete app/test-client-env.tsx - Remove TestClientEnv import from app/page.tsx (line 4) - Remove <TestClientEnv /> component usage from app/page.tsx (line 20) - Verify /api/test-env endpoint returns 404 after removal
- Task 2: Clean up app/page.tsx to production-ready state - Remove or comment out Story 1.2 Tailwind/Shadcn test content - Replace with simple placeholder for Epic 3 frontend work - Keep it minimal - just enough to verify the app runs - Add comment indicating "Epic 3 will implement the actual UI"
- Task 3: Verify production readiness - Run TypeScript compilation: npx tsc --noEmit (should pass) - Run ESLint: npm run lint (should pass) - Run development server: npm run dev (should start successfully) - Run production build: npm run build (should complete successfully) - Verify no console errors or warnings in browser
- Task 4: Move favicon to public/ directory for consistency - Move app/favicon.ico to public/favicon.ico - Verify favicon still loads correctly in browser tabs - Test across Chrome, Safari, Firefox to confirm - Rationale: Aligns with public/icons/ structure, more conventional per Next.js docs - Source: Low severity advisory from Story 1.4 review
- Task 5: Update documentation - Remove references to test files from README if any - Add note in CHANGELOG or README about Epic 1 completion - Document that foundation is ready for Epic 2

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. **Given** Epic 1 stories are complete and validated **When** I clean up test artifacts **Then** all temporary test files created during Epic 1 validation are removed **And** the app/page.tsx landing page is restored to a clean state without test components **And** no test-related imports remain in production code **And** the development server runs successfully without the test files **And** the production build completes successfully

constraints.constraint: TypeScript strict mode must be maintained - no compilation errors allowed
ESLint must pass with no warnings or errors
Development server (npm run dev) must start successfully after cleanup
Production build (npm run build) must complete successfully after cleanup
All Shadcn UI components must remain intact - they will be used by Epic 3
lib/env.ts must NOT be removed - it's essential for Epic 2+ environment management
Do not remove any configuration files (next.config.ts, tailwind.config.ts, tsconfig.json, etc.)
Cleaned app/page.tsx must maintain valid Next.js App Router structure
Next.js 16 conventions must be followed for all remaining code
Favicon must end up in public/ directory, not app/, per Next.js conventions

tests.standards:
For Story 1.6, testing is verification-based rather than automated testing. The story requires manual verification that: 1. TypeScript compilation passes (npx tsc --noEmit) 2. ESLint passes with no warnings (npm run lint) 3. Development server starts successfully (npm run dev) 4. Production build completes successfully (npm run build) 5. No console errors or warnings in browser 6. Test files no longer exist in the codebase 7. Favicon loads from public/ directory
No automated test framework is configured yet in Epic 1. Future epics (Epic 5) will add comprehensive testing infrastructure.
tests.locations: No test directory currently exists. Testing for this story is manual verification via build commands and browser inspection.
